purifier_comparison_reply:
**Commercial Air Purifier vs. DIY Corsi-Rosenthal (C-R) Box:**

| Feature | Commercial HEPA Purifier | DIY Corsi-Rosenthal Box |
|---|---|---|
| **Upfront Cost** | ₹10,000 – ₹25,000 INR | **₹3,000 – ₹4,000 INR** |
| **Clean Air Delivery (CADR)** | 150 – 250 CFM | **350 – 450 CFM** (superior airflow) |
| **Filtration Level** | True HEPA (99.97%) | MERV-13 (90-95% for PM2.5) |
| **Room Coverage** | Ideal for 120–200 sq ft bedroom | Excellent for large living rooms (400+ sq ft) |
| **Noise Level** | Very quiet (sleep mode) | Moderate fan hum |

**Verdict:** If budget is a constraint or you need to clean a large shared living space/classroom, the DIY Corsi-Rosenthal box provides the highest clean air per rupee.
